business_summary.text: Geojit Financial Services Limited is a financial services company focused on stockbroking, mutual fund distribution, wealth management, and insurance distribution, with a presence across Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities in India and operations in GCC countries.

call_points.text: Operating leverage expected to emerge as investments in distribution and IT begin to yield productivity gains.
Asset Management ARR net flows grew 353% YoY to ₹322 Cr, showing strong momentum in the PMS and AIF business.
EBITDA and PAT declines reflect continued heavy investment in IT infrastructure and expanding the field force.
Customer assets remained stable at ₹1.12 lakh Cr as inflows were offset by negative market-linked mark-to-market movements.
Management expects operating leverage to emerge in next couple of quarters as investments in sales force and technology start yielding productivity gains
Continued investment in technology and people for next 2 years to build recurring revenue platform
Cash balance around ₹1,100 Cr, with 70% used for MTF lending and NBFC activities
GCC business facing headwinds from Middle East conflict and FCNR rate hikes, leading to wait-and-watch approach
IT transformation investment is lined up at about ₹30 crores for the next 3 years.
Hiring for the field has been paused due to the West Asian crisis creating uncertainty.
